source: Conceptually, if the tensor payload moved from 16-bit storage to ideal 8-bit storage, the elementstorage component would halve. Real implementations also require scales, alignment, metadata, and backend-specific layouts, so practical memory savings need not equal the ideal bit-width ratio exactly.
zh: 从概念上讲，如果张量有效负载从 16 位存储转移到理想的 8 位存储，则 elementstorage 组件将减半。实际的实现还需要缩放、对齐、元数据和特定于后端的布局，因此实际的内存节省不需要完全等于理想的位宽比。
